title: Wordris
tagline: Letters tumble one at a time into a narrow well.
blurb: Letters tumble one at a time into a narrow well. Steer each one home and spell a three- or four-letter word across or down to score it and clear it, with triple-letter, double-letter and double-word squares to aim for. Letters drop after every word and may spell another for a cascade, and every thirty letters the pace quickens.
controls: Restart (in pause or at game over)

demo.contains: Level 1 demo: the first 30 letters, at the opening speed

quote.text: Clever, tidy and a touch unkind
